headlines.title: Lowe's Companies (LOW) Starts 20 Minute Drone Delivery Pilot
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies (NYSE:LOW) has begun a drone delivery pilot for home improvement products with Wing and DoorDash in Matthews, N.C. The trial offers select DIY and Pro items delivered to customers from the Matthews store in as little as 20 minutes. Wing manages the drone operations, while DoorDash integrates the new option into its app for same day fulfillment of eligible orders.

headlines.title: Lowe's (LOW) Stock Looks Reasonable On a 25% One Year Slide
headlines.summary: Lowe's Companies has seen its share price fall sharply over the past year, so the market has already marked the stock down. That raises a straightforward question for investors who care about fundamentals: do the cash flows that Lowe's can generate justify where the stock trades today? The share price has declined 24.9% over the past year, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current valuation is supported by Lowe's future cash generation.

headlines.title: Is Home Depot’s Dividend Safe if Housing Stays Frozen?
headlines.summary: Home Depot's stock sits near a 52-week low and housing turnover has been frozen for four years, yet the company keeps writing dividend checks. Whether that streak survives depends on three numbers investors should watch closely.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
